cases.name: issue1519_bench_tubes_union_checked
cases.note: #1519 / WR-580: a bicycle frame's top tube (r 16, (-150, 0, 820) to (600, 0, 860)) united with its seat tube (r 16, (0, 0, 300) to (-150, 0, 820)) as SolidCraft's bench builds them (axes rounded to 1e-6, bases and heights to 1e-3, seams 0.6131 rad round from the frame's x), each SmApiCreateCylinder turned about Z for its seam, about Y onto its axis and moved to its base, as crates/solidcore/tests/wr580_tube_joint_no_coincident_edges.rs builds them. At the default fixes (upstream behaviour) this compares the port with the C++: upstream's SmEdgeDefinition::Imprint makes a second edge beside the seat's end circle (SmFace tests 33 and 34), unless the union first fails on #1517 (WR-579), which the default fixes also leave in place. Compares the union's status and SMLib's capi check (level 2) of the result.
